why: A's sofa is the light grey, modern three-seater the client asked for, and the textured mustard cushions add a clean, modern pop of colour; its only weak point is the walnut base of the TV console. B's sofa reads more cream than grey, its dark legs fight the light ash table and pale floor, and the boho tassel cushion drifts from the modern look, even though its all-white console suits the room better.
